messages:
Maya K: starting a canary for model v3.1 tomorrow 09:00 PT. plan is percent + region-based ramp, need quick ops sync + watchlist. PR #2345 merged. :rocket:
Andre: copying. proposed rollout: 0 -> 5% (30m) -> 20% (1h) -> 50% (2h) then evaluate for global. regions: us-west-2, eu-west-1 start, then us-east-1 if green.
Sanjay: image tag is `model:v3.1-20260310`, infra is ready. created feature flag `feature.model_v3_1_canary`. CLI to set: `redwoodctl feature set feature.model_v3_1_canary --percent 5 --regions us-west-2,eu-west-1`
Lia: I'll be primary watcher first 3 hours. can someone add the dashboard link and the monitor list? :eyes:
Eli: added monitors in Datadog: `dd:canary:model_v3_1_latency_p95`, `dd:canary:model_v3_1_error_rate`, `dd:canary:model_v3_1_response_quality`. alert thresholds and runbook in the dashboard notes.
Deploy Bot: rollout job started by Andre at 2026-03-18T16:00Z. job id `rollout-7841`. sending CI smoke results.
Andre: smoke passed. starting 5% window now. gating checks: p95 latency <= baseline*1.5, error_rate < 0.5%, quality_regression < 3% vs control prompts.
Oncall Bot: alert `RT_model_v3_1_canary_errors` created. paging rules: page on >3% errors sustained 5m.
Lia: quick checklist: 1) kafka lag check for async queues 2) embedding mismatch rate 3) hallucination eval job running (`eval-58`) 4) cost burn monitor (token/s)
Maya K: add kill-switch: `feature.model_v3_1_disable` already exists?
Sanjay: yes it's in prod flags, tested. toggle is instantaneous and global.
Eli: pinging @infra for log retention for canary traces (keeping 7d full trace).
Andre: if any monitor fires during 5% window, immediate rollback to 0% and notify infra + oncall. if green after 20% window, proceed to 50%. final decision call at +4h by Maya + Lia.
Lia: I'll take the decision call. I'll post a short summary doc in #eng-platform with the rollup metrics after each window.
Maya K: note for QA: run the regression suite `ci/regress/canary_v3` against the warm prompts set. test owner: @Eli.
Eli: will run, expect results in ~40m. will post failures only.
Andre: small ops note: we'll stagger user subset by customer tier; free tier -> 1st, then paid. reduces risk.
Sanjay: telemetry collection: added header `x-canary-model: v3.1` to requests for sampling.
Lia: oncall coverage: I'll hand over to Oncall in 3h. Oncall, you good to take second watch?
Oncall Bot: acknowledged. Oncall on duty: Sara_O. paging configured.
Maya K: thanks team. after rollout I'll open a short post-roll doc with traffic distribution, regression numbers, cost delta. :thumbsup:
Andre: tagging PRs for the gating code: #2350 and #2351. Eli please review the gating logic patch when you get a chance.
Eli: on it, target review in next 30m.
Lia: reminder: don't promote model v3.1 to dedicated pools until we verify memory usage patterns. keep quantization flag off for canary.
Sanjay: noted. quantization remains `false` for this rollout.
Maya K: final: if anything unexpected, use `redwoodctl feature set feature.model_v3_1_canary --percent 0` to kill. I'll be on Slack for the whole window.
Andre: Roger. starting timers. :clock1:
Lia: adding short alias commands to the runbook: `alias rc=redwoodctl` example: `rc feature set feature.model_v3_1_canary --percent 0`
Eli: eval results posted: 1 minor quality regression on one prompt category, magnitude 2.1% — under the 3% threshold.
Maya K: good. continue ramp to 20% in 10m. will update after 20% window. :eyes:
